gloss: to build, to construct, to brew

definitions.gloss: to build, to construct, to manufacture
definitions.explanation: To create something large-scale such as buildings, ships, or infrastructure. Used for construction and large-scale manufacturing, as opposed to 作る which covers general making and creation.

definitions.gloss: to brew, to produce (alcohol, miso, etc.)
definitions.explanation: To produce fermented or brewed products such as sake, wine, beer, soy sauce, or miso. This is the standard kanji used for brewing and fermentation.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{橋|はし}を{造|つく}る。
この{船|ふね}は{日本|にほん}で{造|つく}られた。
examples.english: This ship was built in Japan.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}に{大|おお}きな{商業施設|しょうぎょうしせつ}を{造|つく}る{計画|けいかく}がある。
examples.english: There are plans to build a large commercial facility in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {日本酒|にほんしゅ}を{造|つく}る。
この{蔵元|くらもと}は{百年以上|ひゃくねんいじょう}{酒|さけ}を{造|つく}り{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: This brewery has been making sake for over a hundred years.

examples.japanese: {自家製|じかせい}の{味噌|みそ}を{造|つく}るのが{趣味|しゅみ}だ。
examples.english: My hobby is making homemade miso.

notes:
KANJI DISTINCTION:
Japanese has three kanji for つくる, each with a different scope:
- {作|つく}る: general making, creating (food, art, documents, etc.) — the most common
- {造|つく}る: building, constructing, brewing — large-scale or industrial
- {創|つく}る: creating something new, founding — emphasizes originality

In practice, {作|つく}る can be used for almost anything, while {造|つく}る is specifically chosen for construction ({造船|ぞうせん}, {建造|けんぞう}) and brewing ({醸造|じょうぞう}, {酒造|しゅぞう}).

GRAMMAR:
Godan verb, conjugates identically to {作|つく}る.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {船|ふね}を{造|つく}る: to build a ship
- {酒|さけ}を{造|つく}る: to brew sake
- {道|みち}を{造|つく}る: to build a road
